comment: Operator overrides for model tiers. "default" applies to every band without its own entry. Each entry may set base_url (OpenAI-compatible chat-completions URL), model (actual slug sent to the endpoint), api_key_env (env var holding the key), price_per_m (USD per million tokens), and send_reasoning (true only for endpoints that accept the OpenRouter reasoning field). Leave base_url empty to keep OpenRouter as the transport. A positive price_per_m also keeps the global spend cap; a zero price is treated as local/free. free_pool is NOT a pin: it is a free-first augmentation layer for the listed bands -- the tier pick underneath stays live, and when every free endpoint is quota-exhausted or failing, the paid pick serves. Each endpoint: name (unique, [a-z0-9._-]), service (key-health group), base_url + model + api_key_env for custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, openrouter_free=true for a zero-price catalog model picked automatically, extra (body fields merged into every POST, e.g. Gemini's reasoning_effort), rpm/rpd/tpm limits (0 = unlimited), pool_key (endpoints sharing one provider rate pool, e.g. all Groq models share the org-wide RPM bucket, share one pool_key so their RPM windows are counted together; defaults to name). A gemini endpoint may set model to "auto": the concrete model is never pinned -- the key's live models list is gathered hourly and the per-band score floor picks the strongest free model (weakest for sublow) with a benchmark score on file. A gemini endpoint's rpd is an endpoint-level daily cap shared by all its models; set it to 0 to ride Google's true per-model-per-key free allowance -- the rotation then only skips a model once Google itself answers with a daily-limit 429, so one key can serve each model's full daily budget. model_rpd (a gemini endpoint may set it) is a per-model cap map: keys match model names by substring with longest-key-wins (so 'flash-lite' is not shadowed by 'flash'); a matching key's value caps that model's daily calls locally, while models matching no key stay uncapped (riding rpd).

bounty.comment: Bug-bounty band: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 via OpenRouter. Empty base_url keeps the OpenRouter transport; price_per_m is the operator's blended estimate ($0.006/M prompt, $0.50/M completion, cache-read $0.005/M -- re-tune as OpenRouter reprices). send_reasoning stays false: the tier pin rides the default OpenRouter body.

free_pool.comment: budget_bands (2026-11-10): bands listed here engage the pool ONLY when credits are paused/exhausted or the spend cap is hit -- they stay on the paid pick otherwise. mid is a budget band: paid mid when credits exist, free mid when they do not. budget_bands semantics (2026-11-10): a listed band must ALSO be in bands for the pool to reach it at all; budget_bands then suppresses it whenever credits are healthy (paid pick serves) and releases it only on credits pause/exhaustion or spend cap.
